label: preparing
what: A likely jubilee celebration or feast in the great hall at day 1, 18:00, presented to me as a lighting inspection. Baker explicitly called the 200 loaves jubilee bread; innkeeper commissioned them and directed hall storage, freight supplied and delivered bread, and builder arranged new lighting and insisted on my arrival at precisely eighteen, not earlier. Secretary knowingly helps arrange my escort and appointment, but my experience does not establish that secretary knows a concealed jubilee purpose. Neighbour knows of the lighting and bread and attends, but knowing involvement in the concealed preparation is not established. Whose jubilee it is, and whether it specifically celebrates me, remain unknown.
